# Set-Up

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(car)
library(corrplot)
library(randomForest)

plots <- st_read("data/processed/fuels_analysis.gpkg", layer = "allplotsDS") 
plots$northness[is.na(plots$northness)] <- 0
plots$eastness[is.na(plots$eastness)] <- 0
plots <- plots %>%
  mutate(across(c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS", "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC"), as.numeric))
```

# Calculate VIF scores

```{r}
model <- lm(prop_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + TMax + PR + VS + VPD + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_Thinning + prop_Wildfire + prop_Broadcast.Burn + prop_Removal + prop_extent_treated + TCC, data = plots)

vif_scores <- vif(model)
print(vif_scores)


#Correlation matrix
plots_corr <- plots %>% st_drop_geometry()
cor(plots_corr[, c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS", "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC")], use = "complete.obs")

corrplot(cor(plots_corr[, c("northness", "eastness", "elevation", "slope", "TMax", "PR", "VS", "VPD", "ERC", "TOTAL_COUNT", "prop_Thinning", "prop_Wildfire", "prop_Broadcast.Burn", "prop_Removal", "prop_extent_treated", "TCC")], use = "complete.obs"), method = "color", addCoef.col = "black")
```

# Random Forest - Prop high severity

```{r}
# Prepare and split data (80% Train, 20% Test)
set.seed(123) # Ensures identical bootstrap results
index <- sample(1:nrow(plots), 0.8 * nrow(plots))
train_data <- plots[index, ]
test_data  <- plots[-index, ]

# Fit the model 
high_model <- randomForest(
  prop_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + TMax + PR + VS + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_Thinning + prop_Wildfire + prop_Broadcast.Burn + prop_Removal + prop_extent_treated + TCC,          # Formula: target ~ predictors
  data = train_data,    # Training dataset
  ntree = 500,          # Total decision trees grown
  mtry = 2,             # Features split per node
  importance = TRUE     # Evaluates feature impact
)

# Print out-of-bag (OOB) error summary
print(high_model)

# Generate predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(high_model, newdata = test_data)

# Evaluate classification accuracy
table(Observed = test_data$prop_high_sev, Predicted = predictions)

```

# Plots - high severity

```{r}
plot(high_model)
importance(high_model)
varImpPlot(high_model)
```

# Random Forest - Prop mod-high severity

```{r}
# Prepare and split data (80% Train, 20% Test)
set.seed(123) # Ensures identical bootstrap results
index <- sample(1:nrow(plots), 0.8 * nrow(plots))
train_data <- plots[index, ]
test_data  <- plots[-index, ]

# Fit the model 
mohi_model <- randomForest(
  prop_mod_high_sev ~ northness + eastness + elevation + slope + TMax + PR + VS + ERC + TOTAL_COUNT + prop_Thinning + prop_Wildfire + prop_Broadcast.Burn + prop_Removal + prop_extent_treated + TCC,          # Formula: target ~ predictors
  data = train_data,    # Training dataset
  ntree = 500,          # Total decision trees grown
  mtry = 2,             # Features split per node
  importance = TRUE     # Evaluates feature impact
)

# Print out-of-bag (OOB) error summary
print(mohi_model)

# Generate predictions on test data
predictions <- predict(mohi_model, newdata = test_data)

# Evaluate classification accuracy
table(Observed = test_data$prop_mod_high_sev, Predicted = predictions)

```

# Plots - mod-high severity

```{r}
plot(mohi_model)
importance(mohi_model)
varImpPlot(mohi_model)
```
